top_signals.title: Kiwi Will Outpace Euro on Widening Rate Gap, Strategists Say
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s dollar is set to rise to the strongest in more than a year against the euro due to expectations the local central bank will outpace its European peer in raising interest rates, according to strategists.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
